rows.title: feat(codex-audit): debounce audits per branch (delta behind setting,…
rows.body:
## Summary
Audit debounce for the canonical Codex audit: an audit for a head starts only after the branch has had no new push for `audit.debounce.minutes` (default 5). A moved tip cancels the pending audit (exit 4, no record) so only the newest head is audited once. `--now` runs at once. The delta re-audit code is included but OFF by default (`audit.delta.maxFiles=0`) until the hardening card lands.

## PREP
- Acceptance: (1) test "a second push within the debounce window cancels the pending audit and audits only the newest head once" (red on main, green here); (2) debounce 5 min setting, `--now` immediate; (3) delta behind the setting, negative tests for merge-path files, WEAKENED basis, invalid basis, throwing deps; the default config never writes a delta record (test). Item 4 (live audit counts per merged PR over 12 h, before/after) is owed after the merge.
- Pre-mortem: stale basis hides a change (basis must be a full record, ancestor, same base, exact diff; and delta is off by default); debounce delays urgent fixes (`--now`; debug briefs pass it); undetermined branch runs immediately.
- Files: scripts/operations/codex-audit.mjs, codex-audit-io.mjs, scripts/settings/codex-audit.json, scripts/operations/__tests__/codex-audit.test.mjs.
- Tests: `npx vitest run scripts/operations/__tests__/codex-audit.test.mjs` (211 pass); verify-lane green with that explicit file.

## Audit
Canonical audit on e4544eef was WEAKENED with 6 non-security findings (5 apply only when delta is enabled, 1 is a malformed debounce setting edge). Waiver recorded by the orchestrator (R1085); a hardening card covers all six.

rows.title: fix(conveyor): bound the fix-daemon orphan guard (per-PR deadline, cu…
rows.body:
## Summary
Fix-daemon orphan guard now honours its budget (load-reducer, R761; OGB steps S1.1 + S1.2, G1 ruled A). It stops between PRs at its deadline and at the adoption handoff (min one PR handled), rotates a PR cursor, redispatches at most one orphan per pass through the pass plan-cache reconcile (no fresh runReconcilePass), and reports real prs/deferred counts. The normal fix phase now runs every pass: only deferred, unsettled or unvisited-repo `review:changes` PRs are held (per PR, from a live listing for skipped repos; exclusions apply before reconcile so no stand-down auto-proceed write touches a held PR). A listing failure still holds the whole repo (fail closed). The capped-orphan invariant test is kept; its repo-level assertion became PR-level on purpose (not a weakening).

PREP
- Acceptance: tier-1 tests (per-PR deadline and cursor resume, one redispatch per pass, injected reconcile, prs/deferred counts, normal fix runs every pass, yield in loop, live-listing hold, no stand-down write for held PRs) red on origin/main, green here.
- Pre-mortem: one redispatch per pass delays an orphan backlog (watch `deferred=` on the orphan-guard pass-timing line); stale cached plan for a redispatch (dispatcher re-reserves its claim, cache fingerprinted, markTouched called); a held PR that gains `review:changes` mid-pass (narrow window, carded).
- Files: scripts/conveyor/orphan-fix-round.mjs, scripts/conveyor/reconcile-fix-dispatch.mjs, scripts/conveyor/reconcile-pass.mjs, skills-src/conveyor/reconcile-fix-dispatch-daemon.mjs, their tests, docs/agent/testing.md, soak break scripts/conveyor/soak/breaks/orphan-guard-bounded-per-pr.mjs (+ .soak.test.mjs), scripts/ci/test-timings.json.
- Tests: `npm run test:unit -- skills-src/conveyor/__tests__/reconcile-fix-dispatch-daemon.test.mjs scripts/conveyor/__tests__/orphan-fix-round.test.mjs scripts/conveyor/__tests__/reconcile-fix-dispatch.test.mjs scripts/conveyor/__tests__/reconcile-pass.test.mjs`; soak break via vitest.soak.config.ts.

## Residual risk (fast mode, R825)
Final audit on 6ec32570: WEAKENED with six findings, all waived under R1085 and carded (single global orphan cursor fairness; defaultListBounced 200-PR cap and empty-output handling; orphan redispatch bypassing auth pause and queue/throttle gates; marker-failure cap accounting). Earlier rounds' new findings (:1984 stand-down writes, :1478 stale-label hold) were fixed in this branch.

The installed runner now has an `egress-self-check <uids>` CLI flag (calls `createRunner().egressReady(uid)` for every uid, fail closed), and forge-setup runs that against the INSTALLED bundle. The check proves the runner that actually runs, and is not deleted.

- Acceptance: (1) egress check uses the installed runner through a real CLI entry; (2) tier-1 test builds the bundle with forge-setup's own bundle() code, asserts no named imports from the installed bundle, and asserts the flag reaches egressReady and fails closed; red on origin/main (2 tests fail there), green here; (3) re-run on the half-installed state completes with no duplicate units or users (below); (4) live proof on Mesa-01 is owed by the operator.
- Pre-mortem: the check is not deleted; sudoers is still installed only after `visudo -cf`; slot-user isolation unchanged (negative tests); no test seams reach the production factory.
- Files: scripts/readiness/forge-setup.sh, scripts/readiness/forge-exec-run.mjs, scripts/readiness/__tests__/forge-setup-heredoc-imports.test.mjs, scripts/readiness/__tests__/forge-slots.test.mjs
- Tests: forge-setup-heredoc-imports, forge-setup-state, forge-slots (82 tests, green). Codex audit on b685a0cd0e: NOT WEAKENED.

rows.title: fix(drain): hold enqueue without head-bound red-team proof (RL A0)
rows.body:
## Summary
RL A0 (review-loop design, operator-ratified 2026-11-21). The drain treated "red team not owed" (a card-only read bound to an older head) as permission to enqueue, so #7289 merged after `red-team:clear` was removed and the carry was refused. Enqueue now requires head-bound proof; with none it holds `post-accept red team unknown(missing) on <head12>: no result, policy-clear or carry for this head; re-run the red team on the head`.

Scope-cut (ruling review.loop.exit.lane-rl-a0): enqueue-time hold only. The queued re-check is A0b.

## PREP
**Acceptance:** Tier 1 `drain-queue-safety.test.mjs -t "holds merge when red-team:clear was removed and the carry was refused"` is red on origin/main and green here. Live replay of #7289 at head 1076a86e prints HOLD `unknown(missing)`. Gate off (WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM / WE_REVIEW_EXTRA_SEATS = 0, or waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue off) keeps enqueue without a result: off means off.
**Pre-mortem:** (1) Throughput: a not-owed PR whose producer never posts a policy-clear stalls; mitigated by the replay below (4 of 45 holds, all true positives) and an actionable hold reason. (2) Relabel race: the label is never read as proof. (3) `scheduled`/`recorded` evidence flags stay true after completion (drain-red-team-evidence.mjs:1156/1183), so only `inFlight` blocks release by proof; the full pending signal is A0b. (4) Stricter `latestResult`: a policy-clear never buries an earlier confirmed break, even after a clean re-review; fail-closed.
**Files:** scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs (`redTeamClearProof`, `redTeamEnqueueHold`), scripts/lib/red-team-gate.mjs (`latestResult`), new soak break scripts/conveyor/soak/breaks/red-team-clear-removed-after-accept.mjs (+ .soak.test.mjs, test-timings entry), tests and fixture pr7289-red-team.json.
**Tests:** drain-queue-safety*, drain-merge-strategy, red-team-gate*, red-team-skip-outcome (1253 pass); soak break (3 pass). Negative tests per merge-path checklist lines 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 12, plus in-flight and break-then-policy-clear sequences from the audit.

## Replay over the 45 PRs merged since 2026-11-21 05:00Z (read-only)
4 holds, all true positives (merged with no result, policy-clear or carry on the merged head):
- #7289 (1076a86e): `red-team:clear` removed by the merger bot, carry refused.
- #7264 (6c50eec9): last red-team result on an earlier head; clear label removed by worker bot after the head moved.
- #7237 (7c57896c): same pattern; result and clear label belonged to an earlier head.
- #7228 (0dd4476e): clear label re-added by the worker bot at 16:58Z with no result on the head; merger bot removed it at 17:35Z.

Verified on the merged sha f2667323: scoped vitest 1253 pass (verify-lane green). Soak: green 3/3 on f2667323.

## Audit (codex-audit on f2667323): WEAKENED, 7 findings, waived by the orchestrator
By design / out of scope: :1313 kill switch (gate off); :1310 in-flight enforced, full pending signal is A0b; :600 a trusted clean re-review legitimately resolves a break (only a policy-clear must not). Inherited from main: :357 check-run path, :473 waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue=false, :571 deadline override, :193 `broken=advisory` setting (carded as a security review of that setting).

## A0b (follow-up card)
- Queued re-check: re-read the thread for queued PRs and dequeue without head-bound proof (drain-merge-strategy.mjs; the 6 queue findings from round 2).
- A real pass-pending signal: scheduled or recorded, with no completed result on this head since the schedule (today those flags stay true after completion).
- Proof also in check-run mode, with `waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue=false` handling, and the deadline override.
- Carry reader: require source evidence, seal and verified patch identity.
- Final evidence revalidation outside check-run mode.

rows.title: hotpatch P8-a: close side doors (name shape, auto-rebase, urgent load)
rows.body:
## Summary
Hot-patch redesign slice P8-a (D6 option B): closes three side doors, about 15 non-test lines.
- `addOverlay` refuses any `hotpatch/` ref that is not exactly `hotpatch/<40-hex>`.
- `runAutoRebase` refuses `hotpatch/*` and escalates (needs-you alert) instead of deriving `-auto-N`.
- `prototype-load` accepts `hotpatch/<sha>` branches only to refuse them: `--urgent` gives `hotpatch-needs-ci-receipt`, a ref suffix that differs from `--sha` gives `hotpatch-ref-sha-mismatch`, and every other hotpatch load gives `hotpatch-needs-ci-receipt` until P8-b adds admission.

## PREP
**Acceptance:** Tier-1 `prototype-load.test.mjs` hotpatch case (urgent refusal, ref/sha mismatch, no load), and Tier-1b cases 1-2 (daemon-overlays name shape; auto-rebase refuses hotpatch/*). Red on origin/main, green here.

**Pre-mortem:** (1) A valid-shaped `hotpatch/<sha>` can still be registered by the `daemon-overlay` CLI without receipt or audit. That is pre-existing on main (any ref registers today), and P8-a only narrows it. P8-b closes it (`admitHotpatch` in `daemon-overlay add`, tip == suffix binding). (2) The `--check` preview can report `wouldRegister:true` for a malformed hotpatch ref. This is a preview gap, closed in P8-b. (3) Refusing all hotpatch loads in prototype-load is deliberate until P8-b, so nothing can load through this path early.

**Files:** `scripts/lib/daemon-overlays.mjs`, `scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/auto-rebase.mjs`, `scripts/operations/prototype-load-io.mjs`, plus tests for each.

**Tests:** `prototype-load.test.mjs` ("hotpatch ref loads only with..."), `daemon-overlays.test.mjs` ("refuses hotpatch refs that are not exactly hotpatch/<40-hex>"), `daemon-rebuild-auto-rebase.test.mjs` ("never re-registers a hotpatch ref; escalates instead"). Verified with verify-lane.

## Live proof
- 13:38 ET: `addOverlay` called from lane-3 with a temp overlay dir, ref `hotpatch/b796b3d95487aee39c7678ec760fd0e9dc5dca35-auto-1`. Output: `TypeError: daemon-overlays: ref "hotpatch/...-auto-1" is not exactly hotpatch/<40-hex> — refusing to add it`. The coordinator accepted this as the P8-a proof.
- The prototype-load `--urgent --branch=hotpatch/<sha>` refusal (`hotpatch-needs-ci-receipt`) is orchestrator-only and moves to P8-b's live proof.

## Audit and waiver (R1085)
Canonical audit on 74d87751cc3c52e42777861a657e51b366f272dd, round 2: WEAKENED with 3 findings. The waiver is recorded: findings 1-2 are pre-existing on main and finding 3 is a preview gap, all closed in P8-b.
- scripts/lib/daemon-overlays.mjs:264 — Valid hotpatch names still register without CI receipts or an own-SHA NOT WEAKENED audit. The existing CLI calls addOverlay directly (scripts/daemon-overlay.mjs:1037), bypassing prototype-load’s refusal; rebuild audit enforcement also exempts first-time registrations (scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/audited-tip.mjs:86).
- scripts/lib/daemon-overlays.mjs:264 — The guard validates only the name’s shape, not that the branch resolves to its suffix SHA. The CLI’s expected-SHA check is optional (scripts/daemon-overlay.mjs:959), so hotpatch/<A> can register commit B despite the claimed SHA pinning.
- scripts/daemon-overlay.mjs:979 — The --check path can report wouldRegister:true for malformed hotpatch refs that the new addOverlay guard rejects. Preview bypasses that validation, weakening its assurance that it checks the same admission conditions as registration.

Fast mode (R825): residual risk disclosed above; reinforce-later card is P8-b.
